summary: Phase 4 (Workflow Execution Engine + Checklist API + Starter Flow Library + Test-Run UI) fully passing. Backend pytest 19/19 covering: (a) simulate condition branching — Hot lead follows output_1 to send_email, Warm lead follows output_2 to task; (b) simulate uses latest lead when lead_id omitted; (c) wait node pauses run.status='waiting' with resume_at set + does NOT execute past the wait; artisan 'crm:flow-run' reports 'N resumed' and completes the run executing the send_email after wait; (d) real new_lead trigger via POST /api/v1/chatbot creates a non-simulated WorkflowRun (simulated=false) and a Task is created; (e) lead capture is NOT broken even when workflow has a dangling connection; (f) checklist API returns whatsapp/email arrays with exists=true when a WhatsappTemplate row matches by name, false otherwise; (g) runs endpoint eager-loads lead.name; (h) RBAC — admin+process_admin get 200, sales_head gets 403 on simulate/runs/checklist; (i) regression: partner /leads 403, accounts_support edit lead 403. Frontend (as process_admin at #/workflows): workflow-builder loads with all topbar buttons present (wf-templates, wf-testrun, wf-validate, wf-activate, wf-save). Clicking wf-templates opens wf-starter-picker with all 3 starter cards (lead5/nrty/booking); wf-starter-lead5 clears canvas and builds a fully-connected 8-node flow (8 .drawflow-node + 7 .connection paths) — Mission Checklist correctly updates to WhatsApp=2, Email=1, Task=1, Total=8. wf-testrun saves and opens wf-run-panel with 6 execution steps (wf-run-step-0..5) and a status badge; wf-run-close dismisses it. After save, right-panel 'Templates to create' section appears with wf-checklist-<name> rows and a 'Create' deep-link (wf-create-<name>) that navigates to #/waTemplates or #/emailDesign as appropriate. No console/page errors during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: FlowEngine::walk MAX_STEPS=60 prevents infinite loops but on hitting the cap the run is marked completed silently — consider marking status='failed' with a 'max_steps_exceeded' log entry for observability.

FlowEngine::resumeDue does not update status when a $wf or $lead is deleted mid-wait — it sets 'failed' but the log array is not appended with a reason. Add a log entry so operators can tell WHY the run failed.

WorkflowController::simulate uses Lead::latest('id')->first() unconditionally when no lead_id provided — could pick a soft-deleted or non-owner lead. Acceptable for demo but consider scoping to workflow owner or filtering by status.

FlowEngine::trigger loads ALL active workflows for every lead capture (foreach in the request thread). At scale this should be queued (dispatchAfterResponse or a job) so lead creation latency isn't affected. Currently OK because wrapped in try/catch and lead capture isn't blocked.

checklist() in WorkflowController lowercases template names for the exists check, which is correct, but response 'name' field preserves original casing — good. However, if two send nodes use the same name with different casing, only the last one wins (array key collision on $wa[$tpl]) — probably fine but noted.

WorkflowRun.log is JSON-cast but has no upper size guard; a runaway flow (still bounded by MAX_STEPS=60) is fine, but if MAX_STEPS is raised later this could grow unbounded — consider truncating/summarising on save.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_* workflows (auto-cleaned by module fixture that deletes rows where name LIKE 'TEST_%' before/after), a few TEST_p4_* leads via /chatbot, and one WhatsappTemplate named 'chklist_wa_exists' for checklist exists-flag test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 fully green. Notes for future: (1) Login button is NOT type='submit' — use get_by_role('button', name='Sign in'). (2) To reset engine state: php artisan tinker --execute="App\Models\WorkflowRun::query()->delete(); App\Models\Workflow::query()->delete();" (cwd /app/laravel-crm). (3) Engine only needs data.node_type + outputs.connections in the graph (no html required) — good for API-only tests. (4) When testing wait/resume, set WorkflowRun.resume_at to a past time via tinker then run 'php artisan crm:flow-run'. (5) UI drag-drop is unreliable via Playwright — the Starter picker (wf-templates) is the reliable way to build a canvas for UI test coverage. (6) Real new_lead trigger fires from the public /api/v1/chatbot endpoint (no auth) — good for smoke tests.
